games.description: A completed solo escape from a nightmare airplane. Sark sneaks around the patrolling creature, hunts keycards and badges, decodes the binary puzzle, works through the cockpit clues, and reaches the ending after a difficult final route.
games.title: Flightmare

games.description: Egyptian tomb expeditions in co-op and VR, followed by a solo Halloween return. Sark and his crews learn evidence, traps and relic extraction, revisit new mechanics, discover banishment puzzles, and collect the seasonal pumpkins and cosmetic reward. The seasonal solo recording begins after a stream restart.
games.title: FOREWARNED

games.description: A co-op escape attempt with Bruce Greene and NFEN. The trio learn the floor objectives, work through sword and shrine puzzles, and abandon the run after repeated deaths and revival trouble.
games.title: Hajis

games.description: A co-op laboratory investigation with Bruce Greene and NFEN. The crew learn the tutorial, search for experiment evidence on the first map and try the second location before stopping after repeated monster attacks.
games.title: Inside the Labs

games.description: Three attempts to investigate Nessie: the first with Bruce and Diction, a solo recon visit, and a later return with Bruce and NFEN. Rowing, equipment handling, failed evidence searches and the pocket Pong game repeatedly get in the way.
games.title: Loch Ness

games.description: Sark, Bruce and Nick search the neighborhood chief’s house for keys and chest tools. Repeated escapes and lobby retries culminate in a VIP effort to get Sark out.
